# Content Collections Guide

## Purpose

This directory contains Astro Content Collections for evidence articles.

## Directory Structure

```
content/
├── config.ts        # Collection definitions
└── evidence/       # Evidence markdown files
    ├── apostle-martyrdom.md
    ├── big-bang.md
    ├── dna-evidence.md
    └── ...
```

## Collection Schema

```typescript
// src/content/config.ts
import { defineCollection, z } from 'astro:content';

const evidence = defineCollection({
  type: 'content',
  schema: z.object({
    title: z.string(),
    description: z.string(),
    category: z.enum(['scientific', 'historical', 'catholic']),
    order: z.number(),
    icon: z.string().optional(),
    externalResources: z.array(
      z.object({
        title: z.string(),
        url: z.string().url(),
        type: z.enum(['book', 'video', 'article', 'website']).optional(),
      })
    ).optional().default([]),
  }),
});

export const collections = { evidence };
```

## Adding New Evidence

Create a new `.md` file in `src/content/evidence/`:

```markdown
---
title: "Your Title"
description: "Brief description"
category: scientific | historical | catholic
order: 1
icon: "🔬"
externalResources:
  - title: "Resource Title"
    url: "https://example.com"
    type: book | video | article | website
---

Your markdown content here...
```

## Querying Content

```astro
---
import { getCollection } from 'astro:content';

const allEvidence = await getCollection('evidence');
const sortedEvidence = allEvidence.sort((a, b) => a.data.order - b.data.order);
---

{sortedEvidence.map((item) => (
  <a href={`/evidence/${item.slug}`}>
    {item.data.title}
  </a>
))}
```
